name.ja: HG 1/144 ゲルググ スガイ機(GQ)

description.ja: 『機動戦士Gundam GQuuuuuuX』(ジークアクス)より、「ゲルググ スガイ機」をHGで立体化！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX " (Sieg Ax), " Gelgoog Sugai Machine" is made into a three-dimensional HG!

description.ja: • 劇中に登場したカラーリングでスガイ機が立体化
description.en: • The Sugai machine is now three-dimensional with the coloring that appeared in the movie.

description.ja: • ライフル、サーベルは両手に装備可能
description.en: • Rifle and saber can be equipped in both hands

description.ja: • 背面スラスターはフレキシブルに可動
description.en: • Rear thruster can be moved flexibly

description.ja: • ワイヤーはリード線で表現
description.en: • Wires are represented by lead wires.

description.ja: • サーベルはHGオリジナルギミックで上下両方へ取り付け可能
description.en: • The saber is an HG original gimmick and can be attached to both the top and bottom.
